parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: A wooden drawer located under the tabletop, used for storage.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a compartment for storing small items such as stationery or accessories.
parts.Movement_description: It can slide in and out along rails for access.

parts.name: Back Panel
parts.Basic_description: A wooden back panel that supports the rear structure of the table frame.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural stability and connects the side panels.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel (Left)
parts.Basic_description: A vertical wooden side panel on the left side of the table frame.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the drawer and connects the tabletop to the legs.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel (Right)
parts.Basic_description: A vertical wooden side panel on the right side of the table frame.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the drawer and connects the tabletop to the legs.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Front Panel
parts.Basic_description: A decorative wooden front panel located below the drawer.
parts.Functional_description: It provides aesthetic appeal and structural support to the front of the table.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Leg (Front Left)
parts.Basic_description: A curved wooden leg supporting the front left corner of the table.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the table and maintains balance.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Leg (Front Right)
parts.Basic_description: A curved wooden leg supporting the front right corner of the table.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the table and maintains balance.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Leg (Back Left)
parts.Basic_description: A curved wooden leg supporting the back left corner of the table.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the table and maintains balance.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Leg (Back Right)
parts.Basic_description: A curved wooden leg supporting the back right corner of the table.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the table and maintains balance.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Tabletop
parts.Basic_description: A flat wooden tabletop forming the main surface of the table.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a surface for placing objects, writing, or working.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.
